Name: Vanilla Tweaks Style Botany of Teyvat
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
I've expressed my absolute love and adoration for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/oclarina]Oclarina[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url] many many times, but I also can't live without [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]mrtaiyou[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] series. That meant having a bit of clash between the different styled seeds - so I decided to fix that, and this is the result!
[line]
[b][i][color=#dbb0a7][size=3]Features[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*]All seeds and saplings from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]' style
[*]Choose between [i]Seasonal[/i] and [i]Non-Seasonal[/i] seed bags
[*]Choose between [i]Saturated[/i] and [i]Desaturated[/i] versions
[*]Toggle crop seeds, bush planters, and tree saplings on or off (as groups, there's no individual item toggles [size=1][i]yet[/i][/size])
[*]Configure it all with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿!
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#dbb0a7][size=3]Installation[/size][/color][/i][/b][list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks - Farming Edition[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod
[*]Extract and drop into your mods folder
[*]You're done!
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#dbb0a7][size=3]Notes[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*]There's no individual item toggles, as I believe doing it by groups is enough. If someone does want individual toggles do let me know though!
[/list]
...Also since you're already here for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url], may I interest you in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38335]More of Teyvat[/url] as well?[line]
[b][i][color=#dbb0a7][size=3]Credits[/size][/color][/i][/b]
Of course, all credits go to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/oclarina]Oclarina[/url] for the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url] and its items, and to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]mrtaiyou[/url]﻿ for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]' assets!

And I want to give a big thanks to both of them too; to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/oclarina]Oclarina[/url] for such an amazing mod and encouraging me to post this, and to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]Taiyo[/url]﻿ for allowing modders to use his seed bags and saplings to add compatibility with other mods! This is just thanks to both of them being amazing creators and people, so please go give them lots of kudos <3
[line]

Manifest.Name: VT-Style Botany of Teyvat
Manifest.Description: Changes Botany of Teyvat's seeds and saplings to match Vanilla Tweaks!
Manifest.Author: vikich3rry
